parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the promotional activity, in milliseconds (UNIX timestamp). If this parameter is not specified, the promotional activity has no end time limit.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID value is available, you must specify this **ID** value. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: SharePromotionActivityName
parameters.description: The name of the promotional activity.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the promotional activity, in milliseconds (UNIX timestamp). If this parameter is not specified, the promotional activity has no start time limit.
